question: What skills provide synergy bonus levels to Meditation, at what level does each grant them, and which Phrenology sub-skills are involved? List each skill by name.
notes: Corpus golden (wiki): the answer is the Synergy Levels table on the Meditation wiki page (data/wiki/Meditation_5f2d6f60.txt -> doc wiki_Meditation_Connected_Skills, metadata.source=wiki; linked into the skill dossier via skill_Meditation after the nameless-skill _build_entity_index fix, 2026-10-05). Sources + levels: Unarmed 43; Compassion 10 and 50; Phrenology 15; each racial Phrenology (Human, Elf, Rakshasa, Fae, Goblin, Orc, Giant, Demon, Aberration, Crone-Kin, Dwarf) 20. Facts assert every source skill is named and the three non-20 levels (43 / 15 / 10+50) are stated, so a truncated or hallucinated level list fails. The Compassion '50' group accepts the model's list-compression phrasings ('level 10, 50' / 'levels 10 and 50') as well as 'level 50'. Refactored 2026-10-11: the question now explicitly asks for the levels and to list every skill by name, and each level fact also accepts the skill-anchored table form ('unarmed 43' / 'phrenology 15' / 'compassion 10'), because a compact markdown table never contains the literal phrase 'level 15' — an otherwise complete table answer failed for that reason alone (the compressed 'Human, Elf, Rakshasa, ...' list still fails by design: the facts require each sub-skill named in full).
